entries.defect: The defects come from four mechanisms: hull-tube cloth across both legs blended between the thighs, the fit inflating the rest shape to the union of all poses, weights transferred from the nearest body point, and a pose-independent mask turning cloth errors into holes; the new construction removes all four instead of repairing them.
Build every tight garment as a shell copied from the drawn body's region (iso-line cut, clean hems), offset along the normal, in the rest pose.
A shell vertex takes exactly the body's four bone weights and morph deltas at its source point; no weight transfer, no smoothing, no unposing.
Allow hull fill only where the region is weighted ≥ 0.9 to one trunk bone, plus up to ~1 cm ease on convex parts tapering to the base offset at creases, plus a rim strip at every open edge.
Trousers become a shell (hips below the girdle, thighs, knees, shins to mid-shin); this is the fix for report (1), whose suspected cause is inner-thigh weights taken from the other leg or the hips.
Shell band with hull fill between chestTop and under the bust; removes the flange and the sternum gape.
Trunk and short sleeves as a shell (toga and Maasai left-shoulder cape with a diagonal top edge); the part below the girdle is a driven skirt welded to the shell's bottom ring.
Waist beads, girdle bands, neck ring, chest neck beads and limb rings become thin shell bands with exact weights.
Everything hanging free below the crotch is a cone of columns hung from the girdle ring, rest shape round the hips' hull with a few millimetres of ease and no per-pose inflation.
Add 12 column bones × 2 segments round the hips, parented to hips; skirt vertices weighted only to hips and the two nearest columns, never to thighs or shins.

One pure driver function per frame after IK and lean: each column's upper segment is pushed outward until it clears both thighs by leg radius plus ease, the lower segment likewise against the shins blended toward gravity; TypeScript in the game, a Python mirror in gamepath.py held equal by the runtime round trip.
Short skirt, loin flap and apron panels hang on the driven columns; this is the fix for report (2), the diaper box.

Replace the per-slot LAYER table with an explicit per-form offset rank (ornaments 0, bands/breast cloth/veil 1, trousers/skirts/waist wrap 2, shirt/robe/toga/chest wrap 3, hood 4, cape/cloak 5); shell offset and skirt ease grow with the rank.
Hood is rank 4 under the rank-5 cloak; outfits #83/#85/#87 wear both shoulder-slot garments, so the one-per-slot assumption is dropped.

The cover mask becomes exact pose-independent face sets: body or inner-shell faces inside a higher-rank shell's source region are cut; nothing is hidden under a driven panel; the push class and garmentPush are removed.
Cloak = rank-5 shoulder-yoke shell plus a back panel and two front panels open at the sides, upper part rigid on chest/spine as a ruled surface past the bust, lower part on the skirt columns.
A rank-5 shell over shoulders and upper arms to above the elbow with a dropped hem lip.
A diagonal shell sash from the covered shoulder to the opposite hip plus a short back panel on chest/spine.
Built with the toga construction at knee length; one builder fewer.
Head part rigid as today; shoulder part a rank-4 shell blending from head through neck into body weights.
A rank-1 shell over the lower face and the whole neck, continuing ~4 cm under the collar of the robe, shirt or cloak yoke.
Stays rigid, moved to mid-back on spine1 against the cloak's back panel.
Turban, cap, headband, head ring, topknot, hair bag, hair cap and eyes stay as built today (no inventory defect).

Accept and judge by picture: inherited body LBS pinching, shell self-intersection inside deep creases, long hems entering the ground in kneel/dig, front-corner creases between columns, a small thigh-top contact under the girdle ring in dig, the tighter look of trousers (OPEN: wide-trouser volume).

Remove the hull/ring sweep builders, weight transfer, smoothing, skirt_weights, push_out, unskin, armholes, OUTER/SKIRTS, all of fit.py, mask.py's volume/motion/push classes and the VILLAGER_ASSET fit/settle/mask values only they read.

Keep body, mhbody, rig, clips, gltfio, export (plus column bones), gamepath (plus driver mirror), sheets/inventory (applying the driver), the rigid head builders, and penetration.py as information only on the driven pose.

Pipeline drops from minutes (fit, settle, per-pose mask) to seconds; runtime stays one merged geometry and one draw call per figure, vertex count of the order of today, ~24 extra bones and ~24 vector operations per figure per frame.
Rank offsets (~3 mm base + ~3 mm per rank), column count, skirt ease and the leg-radius factor go into src/config/balance.ts marked calibratable.
Restrict no generated combination; keep the §19.15 open-outer-garment rule in the generator; add a build-time error for two worn garments of the same rank.
Shells (trousers, breast cloth) first, then the skirt rig with the short skirt, then robe/toga/wraps, then cloak/cape/hood/veil, then the mask simplification and removals.

In-game side-on re-shots at 3 m and 7 m of walking and running trouser wearers and of children in short skirt, loin flap and apron, plus robe/toga/wrap wearers in walk/sprint/kneel/dig and the Tuareg rows, and the 158-outfit motion sheets; the picture is the gate.
